mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate indicates monetary easing, which may lead to increased borrowing and investment, thus driving up S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are not higher than the baseline during periods of monetary easing, this hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate below 4% signals a strong labor market, which may lead to increased consumer spending and higher S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 returns are not positively correlated with decreasing unemployment rates below 4%, this hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which may lead to higher corporate earnings and thus higher S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If retail sales growth does not correlate with positive S&P 500 returns over a 60-day horizon, this hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low unemployment (UNRATE) and increasing employment (PAYEMS) signals a strong economy, leading to higher S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the joint behavior of UNRATE and PAYEMS does not predict positive S&P 500 returns, this hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates increased economic activity, which may lead to higher S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If industrial production growth does not correlate with positive S&P 500 returns, this hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates monetary tightening, which may lead to lower S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 returns are not negatively correlated with increasing federal funds rates above 5.5%, this hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong demand in the housing market, which may lead to higher S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If housing starts growth does not correlate with positive S&P 500 returns, this hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong GDP growth (GDPC1) and low inflation (CPIAUCSL) indicates a healthy economy, leading to higher S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the joint behavior of GDPC1 and CPIAUCSL does not predict positive S&P 500 returns, this hypothesis is rejected.
